changelog: Nobody you do not know is put in front of you, including when you install. Setup used to end by listing strangers who were online and what they were working on, and "who's on /vibe" listed every signed-in person. Now you see the people you know by name and everyone else as a number. Setup also only touches Claude Code now, and signing in again no longer wipes the settings you had.
features: Setup no longer lists strangers or how many people are online
Who's on /vibe: people you know are named with what they are working on; everyone else is counted ("and 7 other people you have not written to")
Setup configures Claude Code only. It no longer writes Codex or Cursor settings; anything it wrote there before is left alone
Signing in again keeps your other settings, and keeps the sign-in file private to you
One sign-in per identity: an expired leftover sign-in for the same handle is removed when you sign in
Not changed by this update: the service itself still returns the full list to any signed-in app. That is being fixed on the service side
